title: Doob
wikitext:
Best Brazilian QW player from 2002 untill 2011, Doob (a.k.a. ric or db) holds the biggest amount of titles in Brazil's QuakeWorld history/scene. With a Q3 background since 1999, he started playing both games at 2001 but in 2002 he focused in QW only and started his successful track, carving his name in Quake scenario (worldwide I would say, since CHTV had a quite global impact at the time). Having [[Mur]] as his 2v2 partner, both were almost unbeatable for many years and it was one of the biggest partnership of brazilian QuakeWorld community.

* '''Real name: Ric'''
